```{r}
find_project_root <- function(start) {
  path <- normalizePath(start, winslash = "/", mustWork = FALSE)
  repeat {
    if (file.exists(file.path(path, ".unaltraweb", "computations.yml"))) {
      return(path)
    }
    parent <- dirname(path)
    if (identical(parent, path)) {
      stop("Project root not found: missing .unaltraweb/computations.yml")
    }
    path <- parent
  }
}

root <- find_project_root(getwd())
library(ggplot2)

theme_tigit <- function(base_size = 15) {
  theme_minimal(base_size = base_size) +
    theme(
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.major.x = element_line(color = "#e0e6eb", linewidth = 0.35),
      axis.line = element_line(color = "#17202a", linewidth = 0.4),
      axis.ticks = element_line(color = "#17202a", linewidth = 0.3),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 15, color = "#17202a", face = "bold"),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 15, color = "#52616b"),
      legend.title = element_blank(),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 15, color = "#52616b"),
      legend.position = "top",
      strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", color = "#17202a", size = 15),
      strip.background = element_rect(fill = "#eef2f5", color = NA),
      plot.margin = margin(8, 12, 8, 8)
    )
}

format_percent <- function(x, digits = 1) {
  gsub(".", ",", sprintf(paste0("%.", digits, "f%%"), x), fixed = TRUE)
}

population <- read.csv(
  file.path(root, "_practices/tigit-projecte-territorial/data/raw/poblacio-vila-seca-salou-edat-sexe-naixement-2021.csv"),
  fileEncoding = "UTF-8",
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

age_codes <- population$age_code[population$age_code != "TOTAL"]
age_codes <- unique(age_codes[order(population$age_order[population$age_code != "TOTAL"])] )
age_labels <- c(
  "0-4", "5-9", "10-14", "15-19", "20-24", "25-29",
  "30-34", "35-39", "40-44", "45-49", "50-54", "55-59",
  "60-64", "65-69", "70-74", "75-79", "80-84", "85+"
)
municipality_levels <- c("Vila-seca", "Salou")

stopifnot(
  nrow(population) == 456,
  length(age_codes) == 18,
  all(c("Vila-seca", "Salou") %in% population$municipality),
  population$population[
    population$municipality == "Vila-seca" &
      population$age_code == "TOTAL" &
      population$birthplace_code == "TOTAL" &
      population$sex_code == "TOTAL"
  ] == 22781,
  population$population[
    population$municipality == "Salou" &
      population$age_code == "TOTAL" &
      population$birthplace_code == "TOTAL" &
      population$sex_code == "TOTAL"
  ] == 28314
)

age_totals <- population[
  population$age_code != "TOTAL" &
    population$birthplace_code == "TOTAL" &
    population$sex_code == "TOTAL",
  c("municipality", "age_code", "age_order", "population")
]
names(age_totals)[4] <- "age_total"
foreign_born <- population[
  population$age_code != "TOTAL" &
    population$birthplace_code == "ESTR" &
    population$sex_code == "TOTAL",
  c("municipality", "age_code", "population")
]
names(foreign_born)[3] <- "foreign_born"
shares <- merge(age_totals, foreign_born, by = c("municipality", "age_code"))
shares$foreign_pct <- 100 * shares$foreign_born / shares$age_total
shares$spain_pct <- 100 - shares$foreign_pct
shares$age_position <- shares$age_order + 1
shares$municipality <- factor(shares$municipality, levels = municipality_levels)
shares$label <- format_percent(shares$foreign_pct)

share_rectangles <- rbind(
  transform(
    shares,
    origin = "Nascuda a Espanya",
    xmin = 0,
    xmax = spain_pct
  ),
  transform(
    shares,
    origin = "Nascuda a l'estranger",
    xmin = spain_pct,
    xmax = 100
  )
)
share_rectangles$origin <- factor(
  share_rectangles$origin,
  levels = c("Nascuda a Espanya", "Nascuda a l'estranger")
)

municipal_foreign <- population[
  population$age_code == "TOTAL" &
    population$birthplace_code == "ESTR" &
    population$sex_code == "TOTAL",
  c("municipality", "population")
]
names(municipal_foreign)[2] <- "population_foreign"
municipal_totals <- population[
  population$age_code == "TOTAL" &
    population$birthplace_code == "TOTAL" &
    population$sex_code == "TOTAL",
  c("municipality", "population")
]
names(municipal_totals)[2] <- "population_total"
overall_shares <- merge(municipal_foreign, municipal_totals, by = "municipality")
overall_shares$pct <- 100 * overall_shares$population_foreign / overall_shares$population_total
stopifnot(
  abs(overall_shares$pct[overall_shares$municipality == "Vila-seca"] - 18.69979) < 1e-4,
  abs(overall_shares$pct[overall_shares$municipality == "Salou"] - 38.56043) < 1e-4
)

make_share <- function(municipality_name) {
  rectangles <- share_rectangles[share_rectangles$municipality == municipality_name, ]
  labels <- shares[shares$municipality == municipality_name, ]
  ggplot(rectangles) +
    geom_rect(
      aes(
        xmin = xmin,
        xmax = xmax,
        ymin = age_position - 0.42,
        ymax = age_position + 0.42,
        fill = origin
      )
    ) +
    geom_text(
      data = labels,
      aes(x = spain_pct - 1.2, y = age_position, label = label),
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      hjust = 1,
      color = "#17202a",
      size = 5.3
    ) +
    scale_x_continuous(
      limits = c(0, 100),
      breaks = seq(0, 100, by = 25),
      labels = function(x) paste0(x, "%"),
      expand = c(0, 0)
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(
      breaks = seq_along(age_labels),
      labels = age_labels,
      expand = expansion(add = c(0.55, 0.55))
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("Nascuda a Espanya" = "#cbd5dc", "Nascuda a l'estranger" = "#d95f0e")) +
    guides(fill = guide_legend(nrow = 2, byrow = TRUE)) +
    labs(
      x = "Proporció dins de cada grup d'edat",
      y = "Grup d'edat"
    ) +
    theme_tigit()
}

vila_seca_share_output <- file.path(root, "assets/img/data-visualization/foreign-born-share-by-age-vila-seca-2021.svg")
salou_share_output <- file.path(root, "assets/img/data-visualization/foreign-born-share-by-age-salou-2021.svg")
dir.create(dirname(vila_seca_share_output), showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
ggsave(vila_seca_share_output, make_share("Vila-seca"), width = 4.8, height = 7.2, device = svglite::svglite)
ggsave(salou_share_output, make_share("Salou"), width = 4.8, height = 7.2, device = svglite::svglite)

pyramid <- population[
  population$age_code != "TOTAL" &
    population$birthplace_code == "TOTAL" &
    population$sex_code %in% c("M", "F"),
  c("municipality", "age_code", "age_order", "sex_code", "population")
]
pyramid <- merge(
  pyramid,
  municipal_totals,
  by = "municipality"
)
pyramid$pct <- 100 * pyramid$population / pyramid$population_total
pyramid$value <- ifelse(pyramid$sex_code == "M", -pyramid$pct, pyramid$pct)
pyramid$sex <- factor(ifelse(pyramid$sex_code == "M", "Homes", "Dones"), levels = c("Homes", "Dones"))
pyramid$age <- factor(age_labels[match(pyramid$age_code, age_codes)], levels = age_labels)

stopifnot(
  nrow(pyramid) == 72,
  max(abs(pyramid$value)) < 6,
  all(abs(aggregate(pct ~ municipality, data = pyramid, sum)$pct - 100) < 1e-6)
)

make_pyramid <- function(municipality_name) {
  data <- pyramid[pyramid$municipality == municipality_name, ]
  ggplot(data, aes(x = age, y = value, fill = sex)) +
    geom_col(width = 0.9) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "#17202a", linewidth = 0.4) +
    scale_y_continuous(
      limits = c(-6, 6),
      breaks = seq(-6, 6, by = 2),
      labels = function(x) paste0(abs(x), "%"),
      expand = c(0, 0)
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("Homes" = "#0571b0", "Dones" = "#ca0020")) +
    coord_flip() +
    labs(
      x = NULL,
      y = "Percentatge de la població municipal",
      fill = NULL
    ) +
    theme_tigit() +
    theme(
      panel.grid.major.y = element_line(color = "#e0e6eb", linewidth = 0.35),
      panel.grid.major.x = element_blank()
    )
}

vila_seca_output <- file.path(root, "assets/img/data-visualization/population-pyramid-vila-seca-percent-2021.svg")
salou_output <- file.path(root, "assets/img/data-visualization/population-pyramid-salou-percent-2021.svg")
ggsave(vila_seca_output, make_pyramid("Vila-seca"), width = 4.8, height = 7.2, device = svglite::svglite)
ggsave(salou_output, make_pyramid("Salou"), width = 4.8, height = 7.2, device = svglite::svglite)
```
